parchmentRoomEntry._comment: Hole down into the Parchment Room battle — lives on tile 70 of the real 'Cake Drake Party' room itself (the mission's own gate room, missions.json -> registry.missions.parchment_room.gateRooms), NOT a Sewers reskin and NOT Avar Tar's camp. Only shows once the quest is accepted. See shouldEnableParchmentRoomHole() in Quests.js.

spiderLair._comment: Mother of All Spiders: tile 77 right-click in A Secluded Herb starts the Old Widow battle in Sewers (same room CustomBattles uses for Knarknaknork/Ekatrix/Jakundaf — activationCheck flags keep them from colliding). tileMutations applied via applySpiderLairTileMutations() in Quests.js, same mechanism as alDeeRookieGuard.tileMutations.

taintedSouls._comment: Eclipse cauldron tiles accept the Stuffed Toad and spawn a teleporter (sprite 1959) on tile 81. Entering the portal starts the Ekatrix battle in Sewers until she is defeated.

alDeeRookieGuard._comment: The Rookie Guard: portal on tile 109 in Katana Quest teleports into the Knarknaknork battle in Sewers (same room CustomBattles uses for Ekatrix — activationCheck flags keep them from colliding).

hellgateTreasureRoom._comment: Elathriel's Hellgate Part 1: chat-triggered teleport (not a portal tile) into the Fire Elemental battle in Sewers (same room CustomBattles reuses for Knarknaknork/Ekatrix/Spider Lair — activationCheck flags keep them from colliding).

mornenion._comment: Ab'Dendriel Hive (roomId abwasp) decor mutations for the Mornenion battle, applied tile-by-tile via applyMornenionTileMutations() in Quests.js — same mechanism as alDeeRookieGuard.tileMutations for Sewers.

hellgateLibrary._comment: Elathriel's Hellgate Library: chat-triggered teleport into the Sewers (same room CustomBattles reuses for Hellgate Part 1 / Ekatrix / Spider Lair). The battle only spawns once the Wrinkled Bonelord takes the book — see startHellgateLibraryBattle() in Quests.js.

isleOfSolitude._comment: King Tibianus easter egg: ask him about 'Isle of Solitude' or 'GM Island' to teleport into the Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned as the isle. Pure walk-around, no mission, no battle. Right-click the teleporter on tile 37 to return. See enterIsleOfSolitude() in Quests.js.

visitingTheCleric._comment: Oldrak's temple: pick up the Green Tome in Dwarven Bank Heist, speak with King Tibianus, then follow the arrow on tile 155 of Dwarven Bridge into the Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned as the temple in the Plains of Havoc. Pure walk-around, no battle — see enterVisitingTheClericTemple() in Quests.js.

isleOfTheMists._comment: Isle of the Mists: right-click the path tile inside Oldrak's own temple reskin (tile 127) to step across into this second Sewers reskin for the Fernfang battle — see enterIsleOfMistsBattle() in Quests.js. Both share roomId rkswrs; entering tears down the temple's own (battle-free) scene first, and leaving restores it.

necromantHouse._comment: The Necromant House: Oldrak's follow-up quest after Isle of the Mists — stepping through the tile-127 tutorial arrow inside Oldrak's own temple reskin of the Sewers (rkswrs) starts the 'Lost Scout' battle. See enterNecromantHouse() / shouldEnableNecromantHouseArrow() in Quests.js. Both share roomId rkswrs; entering tears down the temple's own (battle-free) scene first, and leaving restores it. tileMutations do a full remove+add reskin (proper per-tile crop/bank replacement, not CustomBattles' own global sceneSpriteReplacements — see docs/mod_development_guide.md on why the tile-scoped approach is used instead).

draconiaTower._comment: Elathriel’s Draconia Tower: chat-triggered teleport into the Sewers (same room CustomBattles reuses for Hellgate Part 1 / Library / Ekatrix / Spider Lair) re-skinned as a dragon cemetery. The battle spawns on entry; on victory the Dragon Lord and Dragon despawn and An Old Dragonlord places as a board NPC on tile 80 — see enterDraconiaTower() in Quests.js.

draconiaQuest._comment: Elathriel’s Draconia Quest: the final step after Draconia Tower. Chat-triggered teleport into the Sewers (re-skinned) for one last battle; on victory the player uses the Dragonfetish to return to Hedge Maze (item consumed), then speaks to Elathriel to close the quest and receive the Key to Magic (Book). See enterDraconiaQuest() in Quests.js.

realmOfDreams._comment: Realm of Dreams quest (prep for a future quest that actually enters it). Tesha reads the Key to Magic (Book), then sends the player down into the Northern Dragon Lair / dragon graveyard to put out the fire guarding the way to the Realm of Dreams. Chat-triggered teleport into the Sewers (re-skinned as the burning dragon lair) for a Fire Elemental battle. The book is consumed on victory. The player then returns to Darama Oasis and speaks to Tesha, who hands over a Mintwallin Prison Key found among the bones (King Tibianus has a hint line about it; a later quest follows up). See enterRealmOfDreams() in Quests.js.

mintwallinPrison._comment: Visiting Mintwallin (the Mad Mage), Part 1. King Tibianus explains the Mad Mage and grants passage into the Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned as the prison beneath Mintwallin. Pure walk-around, no battle. A Prisoner stands on tile 81 as a keyword Board NPC. Right-click the teleporter on tile 84 to return. See enterMintwallinPrison() in Quests.js.

madMageRoom._comment: Mad Mage Room, Part 2 of the Mad Mage Room quest (mission id visiting_mintwallin). Once A Prisoner's riddle is solved, the tile-84 teleporter in the Mintwallin prison takes the player here instead of home — the Sewers re-skinned as the Mad Mage's monster-guarded room, a battle. On victory the player is sent back where they came from and hails King Tibianus to close the mission. See enterMadMageRoom() in Quests.js.

basiliskLever._comment: The Basilisk Challenges: lever on tile 22 of The Farms, only pullable once the mission is accepted (MissionManager). Pulling it warps into the Basilisk Challenge 1 battle in Sewers (rkswrs), the same shared room CustomBattles reuses for every other Sewers reskin — activationCheck flags keep them from colliding. Same lever-sprite-swap mechanism as the Serpentine Tower Basement lever (tile 64), but this is an independent tile/room/handler. See handleBasiliskLeverTile22RightClickDocument() in Quests.js.

basiliskChallenge1._comment: The Basilisk Challenges, Challenge 1 of 6: the lever on tile 22 of The Farms warps into this battle in Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned via tileMutations (same mechanism as Mad Mage Room / Hellgate / Draconia — see createTeleportBattleQuest() in Quests.js). Only challenge 1 is wired for now; challenges 2-6 will reuse the same kingChatState.basiliskChallengesCompleted[] tracking array once added.

basiliskChallenge2._comment: The Basilisk Challenges, Challenge 2 of 6: lever on tile 22 of The Farms warps into this battle in Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned via tileMutations (add/remove). Boss "Slug King" (gets an on-screen boss HP bar via slugKingBossHpBar); no soul core.

basiliskChallenge3._comment: The Basilisk Challenges, Challenge 3 of 6: lever on tile 22 of The Farms warps into this battle in Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned via tileMutations (same mechanism as Challenges 1-2). 12 Mad Technomancers, no boss.

basiliskChallenge4._comment: The Basilisk Challenges, Challenge 4 of 6: lever on tile 22 of The Farms warps into this battle in Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned via tileMutations. 11 villains (Rat-nicknamed Ghouls/Mummies), no boss HP bar, no reward.

basiliskChallenge5._comment: The Basilisk Challenges, Challenge 5 of 6: lever on tile 22 of The Farms warps into this battle in Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned via tileMutations (add/remove + floorBelow). 10 villains (Fire Elementals/Ghosts nicknamed Mad Sheep), no boss HP bar, no reward.

basiliskChallenge6._comment: The Basilisk Challenges, Challenge 6 of 6 (final): lever on tile 22 of The Farms warps into this battle in Sewers (rkswrs) re-skinned via tileMutations (add/remove). Minotaur-cult mob + boss "The Horned Fox" (gets an on-screen boss HP bar via hornedFoxBossHpBar). Clearing this completes all six challenges; the Basilisk report grants "The Horned Fox Soul Core".

avarTarHideout._comment: Avar Tar's camp near Edron. Sewers reskin, reached via the Edron Wilderness arrow tile (see avarTarTiles). Pure walk-around, no battle yet -- see enterAvarTarHideout() in Quests.js. Original ally placeholder (ally creature at tile 70) replaced with the Avar Tar board NPC; general transcripts only for now.

annihilator_orshabaal._comment: Bubble's Call (Bubble). Sewers reskin as Orshabaal's Lair, tile mutations sourced from a map-editor export of the battle room. See enterAnnihilatorOrshabaal() in Quests.js.

parchmentRoom._comment: Parchment Room Quest (Avar Tar). Gated behind the 'Cake Drake Party' room (missions.json -> registry.missions.parchment_room.gateRooms) — see roomsData.parchmentRoomEntry for the hole tile there. Sewers reskin: a coffin sits on tile 67, guarded by a demon; opening it after the fight (right-click, tile 67) grants the Golden Key (Key 6010). See enterParchmentRoom() / openParchmentRoomCoffin() in Quests.js. Reference: tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Parchment_Room_Quest.

demonHelmetGate._comment: Demon Helmet Quest, part 1 (Avar Tar). The Gate of the Lost Souls below the Hero Cave: going down the Cake Drake Party hole (tile 70, see demonHelmetHoleTileAction) enters this Sewers reskin, a fight against 4 Fire Elementals (battles.json -> demon_helmet_gate). Winning persists gateCleared and keeps the player here; the door on tile 52 (doorTileIndex, the door sprite itself glows rainbow via .quests-rainbow-glow) then consumes the Golden Key (keyUsed), swaps doorClosedSpriteId for doorOpenSpriteId on that tile, and leads on to the demon room (demonHelmetRoom). Map Editor export 2026-09-24. See enterDemonHelmetGate() in Quests.js.
demonHelmetGate.battleDisplayName: The Path to Demon Helmet Quest

demonHelmetTeleporter._comment: Demon Helmet Quest, part 2 (Avar Tar). The teleporter room behind the golden-key door of the gate (demonHelmetGate, tile 52 'Go through the door'). Sewers reskin, a fight against 2 Fire Elementals + 2 Demons (battles.json -> demon_helmet_teleporter). Winning persists teleporterCleared and keeps the player here; the teleporter on tile 83 (teleporterTileIndex, Tile_Highlight_Effect.gif) then leads into the demon room (demonHelmetRoom). Map Editor export 2026-09-24. See enterDemonHelmetTeleporter() in Quests.js.

demonHelmetRoom._comment: Demon Helmet Quest (Avar Tar, after the Parchment Room). Sewers reskin of the demon room below the Hero Cave near Edron (Map Editor export 2026-09-24): 4 demons + 5 banshees (battles.json -> demon_helmet). Accepting in Avar Tar's chat arms the hole on tile 70 of the real 'Cake Drake Party' room (same tile as the Parchment Room hole, see roomsData.parchmentRoomEntry); going down it enters this battle. Victory consumes the Golden Key and returns the player to Avar Tar; defeat returns them to Cake Drake Party. 'remove' lists are the native Sewers sprites (the same set every Sewers reskin removes). See enterDemonHelmetRoom() in Quests.js. Reference: tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Demon_Helmet_Quest.

parchmentAntechamber._comment: Approach corridor before the Parchment Room fight -- reached by going down the hole in Cake Drake Party (see roomsData.parchmentRoomEntry). Sewers reskin, no battle (empty CustomBattle like avarTarHideout). Tile 79 has the highlight/teleport into the real battle (parchmentRoom); tile 65 is a flavor-only examine (green inscription text). See enterParchmentAntechamber() in Quests.js.
